severity_method: POC convention, not an industry standard. High: an expected detection or containment did not occur, or a legitimate destination was blocked. Medium: a visibility or evidence gap while detection still worked. Low: reserved, unused in this POC.

findings.finding_title: Redirect hop missing from telemetry (Two-hop redirect, second hop unlogged)
findings.description: MAL-005 Two-hop redirect, second hop unlogged: redirect hop missing from telemetry.
findings.impact: The SOC cannot reconstruct the complete redirect chain.
findings.remediation: Improve redirect logging so every hop is captured.

findings.finding_title: Expected detection did not fire (Ad-to-credential simulation)
findings.description: MAL-006 Ad-to-credential simulation: expected detection did not fire.
findings.impact: An attack path completed without an alert.

findings.finding_title: Landing event missing from telemetry (Rapidly changing URL)
findings.description: MAL-008 Rapidly changing URL: landing event missing from telemetry.
findings.impact: The journey cannot be followed to its final destination.
findings.remediation: Restore landing-event logging for rotating domains.

findings.finding_title: Expected detection did not fire (Trusted-site redirect)
findings.description: MAL-009 Trusted-site redirect: expected detection did not fire.
findings.impact: An attack path completed without an alert.
findings.remediation: Evaluate the final destination of the redirect chain, not only the first host.

findings.description: MAL-010 Download after click: containment action failed.
findings.impact: The suspicious destination stayed reachable after the block request.
findings.remediation: Investigate block propagation to the enforcement point; add a failure alert and retry.

findings.finding_title: Click not correlated to its impression (Cloaking)
findings.description: MAL-011 Cloaking: click not correlated to its impression.
findings.impact: Impression-to-click visibility is reduced; attribution of the journey is weaker.
findings.remediation: Preserve the impression identifier through the tracker used by this journey.

findings.finding_title: Legitimate destination flagged and blocked (Benign control, partner domain)
findings.description: MAL-012 Benign control, partner domain: legitimate destination flagged and blocked.
findings.impact: A legitimate destination was blocked, causing business disruption.
findings.remediation: Allow-list the approved partner domain and tune the lookalike rule (R3).
